kinds.breakdown: a van broken down across the lane
kinds.shoplifter: a shoplifter running from the grocer (grocer open, known thief out)
kinds.lost_man: a lost man with a suitcase
kinds.dog_loose: a dog loose on the quay
kinds.fallen_man: a man fallen on the cobbles (help him up, rob him or walk on)
kinds.crate: a crate off a lorry at the dock gate (help, take or walk on)

rules.placement: A happening is eligible when its hours and state hold and its people are where routines.json puts them; the director picks among the eligible, never by dice.
rules.repeat: No scene twice within 3 real hours (cool_real_minutes 180); none twice in the game unless its people have changed; none twice in 30 minutes or twice in a week on one street.
rules.return: A helped stranger can turn up days later with a small favour (3.7).
rules.content: No children (a 'lad' is an adult of 18 or more), no alcohol or gambling, no slurs; every scene passes the content gate.

open_points: Every happening's words are TO WRITE for the story lane; the structure (who, where, hours, state, choices, what the town keeps) is here.
One of the eight kinds, the crate, is always at the dock gate by the blueprint's wording; its eight scenes differ by hour and by who is watching.
